# Draft:Swedish-Tunis War

| combatant2        =  Ottoman Empire (De-jure)

The Swedish-Tunis War was a small scale conflict between the kingdom of Sweden and the barbary state of Tunis, nominally under Ottoman rule. The war erupted due to delays of the annual Swedish tribute to the Tunisian bey Ali II ibn Hussein, which was paid in order for the bey to grant safe passage to Swedish ships travelling in the Mediterranean Sea. The delay was cuased by Swedish involvement in the Seven Years war. However, no major battles were fought during this war and the war ended when the payment of the tribute resumed in 1766.
